screens.title: Dashboard
screens.description: Connection health, server version, policy/data counts, runtime configuration and recent decisions at a glance.

screens.title: Workspace editor
screens.description: Policies, data, inputs and tests of a workspace with Rego syntax highlighting, formatting, checks, deploy/pull, bundle import and export.

screens.title: Policy API
screens.description: Lists, reads, creates, updates and deletes the Rego modules stored on the server (`/v1/policies`).

screens.title: Data API
screens.description: Browse the document tree, query decisions with input, explanations, metrics and provenance, and write documents (PUT / PATCH / DELETE).

screens.title: Query API
screens.description: Ad-hoc Rego queries through `/v1/query` (GET and POST with input) and the default decision endpoint.

screens.title: Bundles
screens.description: Build (`opa build`), inspect, sign and verify bundles; the native builder covers releases without `opa build`.

screens.title: Control plane: decision logs
screens.description: Studio serves bundles and discovery and receives decision logs and status reports from OPA agents.

screens.title: Local OPA
screens.description: Start, stop and configure the managed OPA server; live process logs.

screens.title: REPL (opa run)
screens.description: The interactive Rego shell in the browser, with the workspace loaded.

screens.title: Command Builder
screens.description: Every command, subcommand and flag of this OPA release as a form — nothing the CLI can do is out of reach.

screens.title: API Console
screens.description: Any HTTP request against the OPA REST API with presets for every documented operation.

screens.title: Compatibility matrix
screens.description: Measured capabilities of every OPA release and the changes introduced by this one.
